plain_definition: A listing category NYSE Arca has proposed for its own rulebook (proposed Rule 8.800-E) for securities issued by a trust, limited liability company, or other similar entity that can hold a mix of specified commodities, digital assets, Derivative Securities Products, and/or cash -- broader than the exchange's existing Commodity-Based Trust Shares category, which is limited to a trust holding a single commodity.
formal_definition: Proposed in NYSE Arca's filing to adopt new Rule 8.800-E, File No. SR-NYSEARCA-2024-87 (filed 15 October 2024; published Federal Register 4 November 2024, Doc. 2024-25529), alongside a proposal to list and trade shares of the Grayscale Digital Large Cap Fund LLC under the new rule.
